name: Browser
description: Chromium for AW workspaces with an interactive noVNC screen, CDP automation endpoint, workspace cookie-proxy support, and configurable window size.

volumes.reason: Chromium's profile — cookies, localStorage, logins, history. Without it the profile lives in the container's writable layer and dies on every container recreation (every app update, every workspace redeploy). Profile dir only, deliberately not all of /home/seluser: that would drag ~/.cache/chromium onto the host disk, which grows unbounded.

auto_start.title: Auto-start
auto_start.description: Start this app automatically when the workspace starts.

apps.reason: Authentication — this container's Chrome must tunnel through aw-app-proxy's CONNECT proxy, and aw-app-proxy injects/clears its cookies via CDP so it's logged in as the user. See tekflox/aw-app-proxy README.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace installs/loads proxy before browser and keeps proxy loaded while browser is desired.
